## How does pricing work?

Fixed pricing quoted upfront — no hourly billing. Small MVPs start at low four figures; full products vary by scope. A free 30-minute strategy call provides a concrete estimate.

## How do I get started with Tibeb Labs?

Book a free 30-minute strategy call through the website (tibeblabs.com) to discuss scope and cost.

## What does working with Tibeb Labs look like?

Weekly working demos during development, ongoing support post-launch, and a 24-hour maximum response time.

## How can I contact Tibeb Labs?

Through the website at tibeblabs.com, via the company LinkedIn page, or by booking a call directly on the site.

## Does Tibeb Labs work with international clients?

Yes — client work spans the USA (Chicago health & fitness platform, property marketplace) and Ethiopia (retail systems, community apps).

## About Tibeb Labs

Tibeb Labs is an AI-first software consulting and development studio founded by Kalkidan Aleme. We build custom software, AI features, and products from concept to launch and beyond. Tagline: "We build software that moves business."

## Services

### AI Engineering & Automation
LLM features, copilots, agents, RAG pipelines, workflow automation, and data pipelines.

### Product Builds & MVPs
Full-stack web and mobile development, MVP sprints, APIs, design systems, and cloud infrastructure.

### Strategy & Consulting
Architecture reviews, tech due diligence, roadmapping, and maintenance support.

## Products (built and owned by Tibeb Labs)

### LoopCam
A macOS virtual camera for Zoom/Teams that loops your video while you step away.

### Guaro
A cloud POS and inventory system for small shops, with multi-currency trip management.

### Ronen Notes
Collaborative note-sharing with threaded comments — no signup required.

### Mebrek
A temporary email service with auto-expiring inboxes.

## Notable client work

- **Health & fitness platform (Chicago, USA)** — React, AWS, Twilio IVR automation.
- **Multi-shop retail system (Addis Ababa, Ethiopia)** — Next.js, PostgreSQL.
- **Property marketplace (USA)** — Node.js, Fastify, listings API.
- **Community engagement app (Ethiopia)** — React Native, bilingual, offline-tolerant.

## Team

- **Kalkidan Aleme** — Founder & CEO. Handles all client engagements. 6+ years of production engineering across healthcare, enterprise, and startups.
- **Oljira Tesfaye** — Co-founder & CMO. Manages growth strategy and brand positioning.

## Summary

Kalkidan Bekalu Aleme is a Senior Full-Stack / Product Engineer based in Chicago, IL, with 6+ years shipping production software end to end — from React and TypeScript frontends to Node.js and Python services, cloud infrastructure, and the deploy. Founder of Tibeb Labs, where he designed, built, and monetized LoopCam, a native macOS app with real paying customers. AI-native in how he works: he uses coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor) daily and ships LLM-powered features on the Anthropic Claude and OpenAI GPT APIs, with the judgment to know when to drop the model and solve it by hand. Strong on design systems, performance, and product detail — from ambiguous idea to shipped product.

## Technical skills

- **Languages:** TypeScript (primary), JavaScript, Python, Swift, SQL, HTML, CSS
- **Frontend:** React 18/19, Next.js, Vue.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, MUI, TanStack Query, design systems and reusable component libraries, accessibility (WCAG/ARIA), responsive and mobile-first UI
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express, Fastify, Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, GraphQL, auth flows, background jobs
- **AI & LLM:** Anthropic Claude and OpenAI GPT APIs, LLM-powered UX, real-time voice agents (STT + LLM + TTS), prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor
- **Data & Infra:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma, Drizzle, AWS (ECS Fargate, S3, IAM), Cloudflare (Workers, D1), Docker, Terraform, Fly.io, GitHub Actions CI/CD
- **Platform & Quality:** macOS native (Swift, CoreMediaIO and CoreAudio system extensions), Playwright (e2e), Vitest, React Testing Library, PostHog analytics

## Experience: Founder & Product Engineer — Tibeb Labs (2025–present)

Independent software studio. Designed, built, and shipped LoopCam — a native macOS virtual-camera app — solo and end to end: a CoreMediaIO system extension in Swift streaming 1080p/30 frames with a watchdog fallback, plus an optional CoreAudio virtual microphone driver. Monetized LoopCam with a freemium model and a paid Pro tier through Polar, using locally verified signed license keys that work offline, and acquired real paying customers. Ships LLM-powered product features on the Claude and GPT APIs, including real-time voice agents combining speech-to-text, model reasoning, and text-to-speech with structured post-session summaries. Built additional products across web and edge (Mebrek, Bete, Guaro), delivers client work end to end, and maintains open-source projects on GitHub.

## Experience: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — SMYL Fitness Rx (Mar 2025–present)

Health technology startup, remote. Builds and ships consumer-facing product surfaces end to end: React 19 and TypeScript with Tailwind, backed by Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI services on PostgreSQL. Built and maintains a reusable component library (Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix UI) as a shared design system, setting usage standards adopted across the codebase. Uses coding agents daily across prototyping, implementation, and debugging. Owns GitHub Actions CI/CD covering automated testing, Docker builds, and AWS ECS Fargate deployments; integrated Clerk, Twilio, and PostHog.

## Experience: Full-Stack Developer — Kimberly-Clark (Nov 2022–Feb 2025)

Contract, remote. Built enterprise React, Next.js, and TypeScript applications serving 2,000+ users; created reusable component libraries and frontend standards adopted across multiple teams. Cut API response times by roughly 30% through query optimization; improved load and render performance via code splitting, lazy loading, and state-management refinements.

## Experience: Full-Stack Developer — XTIVIA, Inc. (Mar 2020–Oct 2022)

Contract, remote. Built full-stack applications across React and Vue.js frontends with Node.js and Express backends; modernized legacy systems into component-based architectures and architected microservices on AWS, cutting infrastructure costs by roughly 40%.

## Selected products

- **LoopCam** (loopcam.tibeblabs.com) — Native macOS virtual camera in Swift (CoreMediaIO system extension, CoreAudio mic driver). Shipped, notarized by Apple, monetized with a paid Pro tier and real customers. 100% local, zero network requests.
- **Mebrek** (mebrek.tibeblabs.com) — Serverless disposable email running entirely on Cloudflare's edge: Email Workers parse raw MIME into D1, one Worker serves the API, React/Vite frontend, and mail handler. Built solo.

## Education & certifications

B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering, Adama Science and Technology University. AWS Certified Developer – Associate (2023).

## Career FAQs

### What kind of engineer is Kalkidan?
A product-minded senior full-stack engineer who ships end to end — frontend, backend, infra, and native macOS — with deep hands-on AI/LLM experience (RAG, MCP, voice agents, agentic coding workflows). He's founded and monetized his own products, so he brings owner-level judgment, not just ticket execution.

### Where is Kalkidan based? Does he work remotely?
Based in Chicago, IL. Has worked remotely for 5+ years across startups and enterprise contracts.

### Is Kalkidan open to new opportunities?
The best way to find out is to reach out directly — email kalkidan.aleme@yahoo.com or connect on LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/kalkidanaleme).
